name: bluebell_chorus
theme: a beech wood carpeted violet-blue with bluebells on a spring morning, the dawn chorus in full voice, read as RINGING SPHERES at every scale: a flower shaped like a bell, the domed cone cells of its petal full of violet sap, the six-spoked blue pigment assembly about two metal atoms, one metal atom's fog about a hot point, a nucleus whose rind is raised in bulges and sunk in hollows because it vibrates (the seam), morphing up into the Sun, which rings like a bell with millions of tones, its face a checkerboard of lifting and settling patches of fire, then the wood from the air, a violet haze under new beech. Daylight throughout, a violet-blue carpet with acid beech lime, silver-grey trunks and one robin-orange point, stately tempo.

registers.name: bluebell_commons
registers.palette: violet-blue bluebell carpet, acid-lime new beech leaves, silver-grey trunks, one robin-orange breast, a lit spring-morning sky through the canopy
registers.scene: a beech wood floor on a spring morning, seen low and oblique from amid the flowers, a violet-blue carpet of bluebells running away between silver-grey beech trunks under a canopy of acid-lime new leaves lit by the morning sun, a robin with an orange breast on a mossy root, a blackbird on a low branch, a wren on a fallen log, a roe deer upright in a sunlit glade, bumblebee queens at the bells, a sulphur-yellow brimstone butterfly on a stem, one tall bluebell spike raised above the carpet in the foreground
registers.loop_target: a violet-blue bluebell carpet under silver beech trunks

registers.name: bluebell_spike
registers.palette: violet-blue bells, cream anthers, lime-green stalk, silver-grey and acid-lime ground
registers.scene: one bluebell stem seen side-on at eye level in the morning sun, an arched lime-green stalk hung along one side with a row of nodding violet-blue bells, each bell a narrow tube with its petal tips curled back, cream anthers peeping from the mouths, a silver-grey beech trunk and acid-lime leaves soft behind, one bell's curled violet petal tip turned toward the sun

registers.name: petal_cells
registers.palette: violet and indigo domed cells, silver cell seams, lime glints on the crests, a sunken blue-black between domes
registers.scene: the upper skin of a bluebell petal at a cell's width, a cobbled crowd of conical cells each a rounded dome, every cell full of violet sap, thin silver seams between the domes, lime glints on the crest of each dome, sunken blue-black hollows between the cells, dome after dome receding across the petal, one dome glowing a vivid blue at its heart

registers.name: pigment_wheels
registers.palette: vivid cobalt-blue and cream-lime flat rings, silver hub points, violet sap haze
registers.scene: the violet sap of a petal cell at a molecule's width, thousands of flat six-spoked wheels adrift in violet haze, each wheel six flat cobalt-blue rings and six cream-lime rings stacked face to face in pairs, the six pairs radiating as spokes from a hub of two silver points, wheel after wheel tilted at every angle and receding into violet depth, one wheel's silver hub point glinting

registers.name: metal_atom
registers.palette: lime and violet fog in soft shells, a white-hot core point, violet-black open space
registers.scene: one magnesium atom at its own width, a soft round fog of lime and violet glow thinning outward through layered shells, the shells nested and faintly banded, a single white-hot point at the fog's heart, open violet-black space on every side, the dim fogs of neighbouring atoms at the frame's margins

registers.name: rippled_droplet
registers.palette: amber and violet packed beads, robin-orange crests, lime-violet fog
registers.scene: a glowing droplet of tightly packed amber and violet beads in a lime-violet fog, its whole rind raised in broad bulges and sunk in hollows all round, alternate patches lifted and settled, a robin-orange sheen on every crest, open fog about it on every side

registers.name: ringing_sun
registers.palette: orange-gold and amber fire, violet shadow in the sunken patches, a lime-violet rim of flame, jet-black space, one blue-green world
registers.scene: our Sun seen whole in the black of space, its face a checkerboard of lifting and settling patches of orange-gold fire, alternate patches raised and sunk across the whole disc, violet shadow in each sunken patch, a thin crown of lime and violet flame curling off its rim, jet-black space on every side, one blue-green world set in the black beside the Sun, its day side lit

registers.name: wood_air
registers.palette: acid-lime beech canopy, violet-blue haze beneath, silver-grey trunks, a lit spring sky
registers.scene: a beech wood seen from the air low and oblique on a spring morning, a canopy of acid-lime new leaves lit by the sun, a violet-blue haze of bluebells glowing under the trees through every gap, silver-grey trunks rising through the haze, one open glade where the violet-blue carpet lies clear under the sun

music_theme: a luminous glass-chapel bed of bell tones over one deep kick on every downbeat at a stately tempo, bright bird-like figures through the wood and the flower spike, hushed ringing tones through the petal cells, the pigment wheels and the atom, a wide shimmering bell-bloom on the morph from the ringing droplet up into the ringing Sun, then settling down through the canopy onto the violet carpet
